sourceEndpoints: packages/codemode/test/deterministic.test.ts:ends with an error the script cannot catch when the caller aborts,is finished once it has its outcome

scenarios.name: the outcome is visible before the result settles when the caller aborts

inputs.script: try { await tools.wait(1); } catch { text("caught"); } text("after");
inputs.cancellation: after start, while the call waits

normalizations: pi decides the outcome synchronously in the AbortSignal listener, on the thread that calls abort(); the contract pins the visibility ordering (finished strictly before the result settles), not the thread that decides — another caller may observe the decision on the run's own thread

the settle-continuation witness is a .then callback on the result promise; the promise may already be resolved while the callback has not run, so the witness records whether the caller's continuation ran, not whether the promise settled
wall-clock call durations are compared as a presence flag; the deterministic observations do not pin duration values
recorded output and error text are the scenario's own markers
